dt: INFN Fellowship Programme call 29216, apply via INFN portal
e: Two-year postdoc within the INFN 2027/28 fellowship programme on the theory of tetraquarks and other exotic hadrons (Maiani, Pilloni, Polosa, Santopinto). Non-Italians need a PhD from a non-Italian institution, awarded on or after Nov 12, 2018.
n: INFN Genova: Postdoctoral Fellowship in Theoretical Physics (exotic hadrons)
unv: The INFN portal is generic; the deadline comes from INSPIRE. The INFN recruitment portal could not be reached on Oct 21, 2026 (connection reset, HTTP 503); the INSPIRE listing was still open with the Nov 12 deadline.
